Conditions update for Tuesday, November 24.

Start the week with a few turns in Banff’s Backyard! Tuesday’s forecast calls for cloud and light winds with a high near −1°C. We have 3 runs and 2 lifts open.

Lifts run 9:30 a.m. – 4:30 p.m.

Overnight lows will be around −2°C on Wednesday and Thursday before dipping to −6°C by Friday, plus a chance of snow showers on Thursday. For the past few night, our snowmaking crew is putting the cold nights to work, cranking the guns and building coverage to open more terrain.

Full-day tickets are 50% off regular window prices while early-season pricing applies.

An $84 Big Drop Card gets you 40% off adult full-day lift tickets and 25% off Night Skiing all season, with no blackout dates.
